name: Vincent van Gogh
findings: Within his own canvases, russian green turns up as the lightest note in 80% of the paintings that hold it, 3.3x the archive's rate (from 925 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, brazil red turns up as the shadow in 60% of the paintings that hold it, 7.3x the archive's rate (from 925 paintings here).
Rarely uses smoky black, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 925 paintings here).
Pairs deep slate-violet with old lavender more than chance would predict (3 of 925 paintings here).
Pairs black brown with espresso more than chance would predict (3 of 925 paintings here).
His single largest palette family (smoky black, dark jungle green, jet) covers 52% of his paintings here.
Keeps 2 distinct palette families here, from smoky black, dark jungle green to lemon meringue, dark olive brown.
Paints most like M. Therkildsen among the painters in this archive, by palette.
